title: LLMs are Biased Evaluators But Not Biased for Fact-Centric Retrieval Augmented Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing relevance scores and selection frequencies assigned by LLMs to their own generated passages versus passages written by humans or other models in pointwise reranking and pairwise generation tasks.
Analyzing the frequency with which models select the first option presented in pairwise reading comprehension tasks to determine positional preference.
Evaluating the preference for factually correct passages over incorrect ones (even when the incorrect ones are self-generated) to determine if accuracy outweighs authorship preference.
Comparing model preferences for artificially lengthened passages versus normal-length passages containing the same information to check for length bias.
